notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Disciple of Tevesh Szat.
Disciple of Tevesh Szat does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Disciple of Tevesh Szat's first ability by tapping it, targeting any creature.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Disciple of Tevesh Szat triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
